text: Retail sales and industrial output exceed forecasts while exports rise sharply. Real-estate investment and housing prices continue declining across major cities. text: A planned U.S.-China summit faces possible rescheduling as the U.S. president remains in Washington during an ongoing military operation involving Iran and the Strait of Hormuz. Treasury officials state the delay would reflect logistics tied to wartime coordination while trade investigations and tariff mechanisms remain active between the two governments.

text: Iranian oil tankers continue exporting through the Strait of Hormuz while overall tanker traffic declines amid conflict conditions. U.S. naval presence remains in the region while shipments supplying India and other destinations proceed. Oil prices remain elevated and global supply flows operate through constrained maritime passage.
